title: Elodie and the Debt
author: Odile Vane
blurb: Cyrus Ravensworth, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
